header.course_name: Partial Differential Equations and Complex Analysis
header.exam_title: B.Tech Degree S3 (S,FE) / S1 (PT)(S) June 2024 (2019 Scheme)/S3 (WP)(R/S) December 2023 Examination

questions.text: Form the partial differential equation by eliminating arbitrary function from the relation $z = x - y + f(x^2 + y^2)$.
Solve by direct integration: $\frac{\partial^2 z}{\partial x \partial y} = \sin(3x + 4y)$.
Write all possible solutions of one-dimensional wave equation.
Write any three assumptions used in the derivation of one-dimensional heat equation.
Check whether $f(z) = z - \bar{z}$ is analytic or not.
Test the continuity of $f(z)$ at the point $z = 0$, where $f(z) = \begin{cases} \frac{\text{Im } z}{|z|}, & z \neq 0 \\ 0, & z = 0 \end{cases}$
Find the value of the integral $\int_C z \, dz$ where C is the part of the unit circle from $-i$ to $i$ in the right half plane.
Evaluate $\oint_C \frac{\cos z}{z^2 + 9} \, dz$, where C is the circle $|z| = 1$.
Find the Laurent series expansion of $\frac{1}{1 - z^2}$ about $z = 0$
Find the singularities and nature of singularities of the function $f(z) = z^2 \cos \frac{1}{z}$
Solve the PDE $x(y^2 - z^2)p + y(z^2 - x^2)q = z(x^2 - y^2)$.
Solve by Method of Separation of variable $\frac{\partial u}{\partial x} + \frac{\partial u}{\partial t} = 0, u(x,0) = 4e^{-3x}$.
Solve $2xz - px^2 - 2qxy + pq = 0$.
Solve $(y^2 + z^2)p - xyq = xz$

A tightly stretched string with fixed end points. con $x = 0$ and $x = l$ is initially at rest in its equilibrium position. If it is vibrating by giving each of its points a velocity $\lambda x(l - x)$. Find th a displacement of the string at any distance $x$ from one end at any time $t$.
Derive One Dimensional Wave equation.
Derive all possible solutions of one-dimensional wave equation.
Find the temperature $u(x,t)$ in a homogeneous rod of length 2m, whose ends are kept at $0^\circ\text{c}$ and whose initial temperature is given by $f(x) = 100(2x - x^2), 0 \le x \le 2$
Show that $f(z) = e^z$ is analytic for all z in the complex plane and find its derivative.
Find image of the circle $|z - \frac{1}{2}| \le \frac{1}{2}$ under the transformation $w = \frac{1}{z}$.
Show that the function $u = \cos x \cosh y$ is harmonic and find its harmonic conjugate.
Show that an analytic function $f(z) = u + iv$ is constant if $|f(z)|$ is constant
Evaluate $\int_C \frac{2z+1}{z^2 - 2z} \, dz$ where $|z| = 1$.
Find the Taylor series expansion of $f(z) = \sin 2z$ about $z = \frac{\pi}{2}$.
Evaluate $\int_C |z| \, dz$ where C is the part of the circle $|z| = 3$ from 3 to $-3$ in the upper half plane.
Evaluate $\int_C \frac{e^{3z}}{(z+1)^4} \, dz$ where C is the circle $|z - 1| = 3$.

Find Laurent series expansion $f(z) = \frac{-2z+3}{(z^2-3z+2)}$ valid in
i. $1 \le |z| \le 2$
ii. $|z| \ge 2$
Evaluate $\oint_c \frac{e^z}{z^2(z+1)} \, dz$ over the circle $|z| = 2$
Evaluate $\int_C \tan z \, dz$ where C is circle $|z| = 2$.
Evaluate $\int_0^{2\pi} \frac{d\theta}{\sqrt{2} - \cos \theta}$

notes: Part A instructions: Answer all questions. Each question carries 3 marks. Part B instructions: Answer any one full question from each module. Each question carries 14 marks.
